title: Transcription for extensions
description: An extension turning its own audio into text with the transcription the owner chose for meetings (docs/extensions/extensions.md "Transcription for extensions", #8485), with the permission transcription in the manifest's permissions.hub, granted by the user. The manager runs the job on that contribution's replay mode, which checks several sessions against each other: a span where they do not agree comes back as a gap, never as a guess. The extension never sees a key, and never anyone else's audio. One job per extension and two across all extensions at a time; at most 15 minutes of audio a job; a job with no call for 60 seconds is cancelled. There is no budget: the extension keeps its own limits. Plugin-side: only the hub and the program speak it.

TranscriptionErrorCode.description: error.code of the transcription calls besides permission_denied (data {scope: "transcription"}): invalid_params (a field missing or wrong, audio that is not base64 PCM16 or over 256 KiB a call, a job that is not this extension's or no longer runs); assistant_offline (the manager is away: try again); transcription_unavailable (no transcription is chosen, ready or able to replay: the owner sets it up in Settings › Meetings); busy (this extension has a job running, or two extensions have); too_long (more than 15 minutes of audio: the job is ended); timeout (the transcription stopped answering: the job is ended); transcription_failed (the transcription failed the job; data {code}: its error code).

TranscriptionStartParams.description: transcription.start: a job for one piece of audio.

language.description: A BCP 47 hint (zh-CN, en-US); the transcription still follows the speech. Empty: the transcription's own guess.

label.description: A short name of what this is, for the manager's log (its first 40 characters); never what is said.

job.description: The job's id, for the calls after; it is this extension's only.

TranscriptionAudioParams.description: transcription.audio: the next piece of the audio, contiguous with the last: PCM16 little-endian, mono, 16 kHz, base64 (standard, with padding), at most 256 KiB of PCM (8 seconds) a call. The call returns once the audio is with the transcription and no more than 60 seconds wait ahead of it, so sending as fast as it returns paces the job.

TranscriptionJobParams.description: transcription.finish (every piece is sent: wait for the text) and transcription.cancel (drop the job and its text).

TranscriptionSegment.description: One sentence, from and to in seconds from the start of the audio.

TranscriptionGap.description: A span the transcription did not trust any text for (its sessions did not agree: noise, music, crosstalk): say so, never guess.

seconds.description: How much audio the job took.
